Restricted five-action continuation diagnostic, not observed policy success or an OPD gradient. QO−QS identifies a stated-authorship wording intervention, not internal self-recognition. QS−AP matches restart and final request but still changes message/history/quotation structure. AP−AS combines turn completion, restart and a new user request. QS−AS and QO−AO combine placement, generation restart and prompt/task format. CIs are exploratory without multiplicity correction; crossing zero is unresolved, not equivalence. Null quote effects do not establish a content-only mechanism. A value gain without a corresponding Q-aligned evidence-log-odds effect is not recovered evidence assimilation. No Student training, trajectory collection, HLN or OPD was performed by this diagnostic.
